name: Superior Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
label: Quest
description: Superior Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of power?
Items offered to those revered amongst the Dawn are priced quite reasonably. I encourage you to make a purchase!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Choose carefully. There are no refunds.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good day, friend. It was a pleasure doing business with you.
